header.description: DBM: a plain swap through a gate featurizer computes sigma(theta)*x_src + (1-sigma(theta))*x_base; theta trained under L1 with a temperature anneal. Gate width derived from (model, site); note anneal's value IS a list (start, end, frac) - list-typed fields are never sweep axes. WARNING: a fit whose theta never separates - no dimension outside [0.1, 0.9] - can still score 1.000, because Gate._mask is a HARD theta>0 mask in eval mode, so an unseparated theta makes the mask a coin flip on gradient noise and about half the dimensions swap, which at a readout layer scores 1.000. Read fit_diagnostics.json before believing a DBM number: decisive_fraction near 0 means the gate never committed and the score describes noise. The l1/anneal values here are starting points, not tuned ones. That is also why `train` stays in THIS file and is not factored into a block shared with another method family: l1, anneal and the 20-epoch budget are this family's, and a shared block would hand another family these numbers. `train.eval.split` is left open - the eval POLICY is the method's, the held-out dataset is the application's.
